ocean-warming-effects.alt: A central box: the ocean absorbs heat; it has taken up about 90% of the extra heat trapped since 1970. Arrows lead to five effects: water expands, so sea level rises; warm water holds less dissolved oxygen, so fish and shellfish struggle; heat-stressed corals expel their algae and can starve (coral bleaching); fish shift toward the poles or into deeper, cooler water; and a warm surface layer floats on top, so fewer nutrients rise to it.
